strands.name: Introduction to Mobile Phones and Service Providers

subStrands.name: Terminologies, Types, Accessories and Service Providers

objectives.description: Mobile phones acronyms and terminologies: definition of mobile phones and terminologies including GSM, CDMA, mobile phones/cell phones/user equipment, MMS, SMS, call barring, call forwarding, BSI, DCT, FPS etc.
Mobile phone bands and their uses: single, double, tri and quad bands and their uses.
Types of mobile phones: straight, flip, slides etc. and their special maintenance needs.
Phone accessories and their functions: headsets/hands free, earpiece, external Bluetooth, batteries, chargers, cables etc. and their functions.
Types of menus and sub-menus: phone book, message, call, settings, applications etc. and their functions.
Service providers and their codes: major voice service providers and their service codes.
Introduction to computer: definition, identification and functions of various computer hardware (monitor, CPU, keyboard etc.) and software (operating and application) components.
Introduction to internet: web access platforms including WAP/GPRS/EDGE/Wi-Fi/3G etc.
Browsing the web: browsing activities like downloading, uploading etc.
Structure of mobile phones: basic block diagram (power unit, memory unit and radio unit) and functions of each block.
Hardware components: identification, description and functions of various hardware components including CPU, SIM socket, earpiece, keypad, buzzer, vibrator etc.
Software components: various software components both operating and application software.

subStrands.name: Electronic Components, Preventive/Corrective Maintenance, Tools and Fault Finding

objectives.description: Electronic components in mobile phones: resistors, capacitors, diodes, transistors, IC, etc.
Preventive maintenance: definitions, functions, reason, advantages and procedures (cleaning, soldering, de-soldering, re-balling etc.).
Corrective maintenance: procedures for corrective maintenance of mobile phones.

Common tools and equipment for hardware and software repairs: star, Allen key, lead, precision set, multi-meter, oscilloscope, computer set, soldering iron and sucker etc.; software tools for repair such as unlocking software, flashing software, firmware installation etc.
Safety in mobile phone workshop: safety rules and regulations; safe use of maintenance tools; basic safety facilities (first aid box, fire extinguishers etc.).
Common hardware problems: identification of hardware problems such as damaged screen, charging ports, mouthpiece, earpiece, keyboard etc.
Common software problems: identification of software problems such as software corruption, virus attacks, firmware issues etc.
